# vendor/secret-table

Code in this folder is copied (and lightly adapted: import paths only) from
**Secret Table** by mertertek — https://github.com/mertertek/secret-table-game —
licensed under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** (see `/LICENSE` and `/NOTICE.md`).

Origin of each file: `packages/scene/src/<same path>` unless noted:
- `contracts/avatars.ts` ← `packages/contracts/src/avatars.ts`
- `data/characters.json` ← `docs/design/d3/characters.json`
- `data/poses.json` ← `docs/design/d1/poses.json`
- `prototype/model.ts` ← type subset of `packages/scene/src/prototype/model.ts`
